svg.title: Hardware integration: power path, sensors, switches and ESP32 wiring
svg.text: Hardware integration: how everything is wired
Coloured tags are net labels: two tags with the same name are wired together.
POWER PATH: 6 V DC bus on the breadboard
single star ground at the SMPS 0 V (SMPS, buck, panel minus, sensors, drivers, ESP32)
IN: 3.3 V from the ESP32 pins (10 kΩ pull-down
on each input: OFF during boot).
OUT: 0 V or 12 V to the MOSFET gates:
* high-side switches: see the gate diagram
